newsitem.title: USA: Gartner says to buy Datapro Information.
newsitem.headline: Gartner says to buy Datapro Information.

text.p: Gartner Group Inc said Thursday that it signed a definitive agreement to buy Datapro Information Services, a unit of McGraw-Hill.

Gartner issued a news release saying Datapro's subscription-based products provide feature and function data and side-by-side comparisons on thousands of computer hardware, software and communications products.

Datapro's publications provide detailed information in a variety of media on product specifications and pricing, product comparisons, technology reports, market overviews, case studies and user ratings surveys, the release said.
Datapro's proprietary database contains information on about 85,000 products and 18,000 vendors worldwide, the release said.
